MT01/001EN
Sanctuary Guard Dragon
Normal Unit｜ Royal Paladin｜ Grade 3｜ Power 11000｜ Shield -
[CONT](VC)[Limit-Break 4](This ability is active if you have four or more damage):During your turn, this unit gets [Power] ＋3000 for each of your grade 1 or less <Royal Paladin> rear-guards.
[AUTO]:[Choose a <Royal Paladin> from your hand, and discard it] When this unit is placed on (VC), you may pay the cost. If you do, search your deck for up to one grade 1 or less <Royal Paladin>, call it to (RC), and shuffle your deck.
[CONT](VC/RC):Lord (If you have a unit without a same clan as this unit, this unit cannot attack)
